root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: failed deep validation of the promised ResourceRecord array must reject the malformed nonzero resourcesZ instead of neutering it to 0 and returning success
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the first sfnt ResourceTypeRecord, the malformed resources array reference must be rejected at `resourcesZ.sanitize (c, type_base, get_resource_count (), data_base)`. Returning success after rewriting `resourcesZ` to null leaves the later dfont face lookup operating on the null pool and is the missing root obligation identified by the sanitizer-grounded trace.
root_cause_criterion.description: For the witnessed first sfnt type record (`resourcesZ=44`, `get_resource_count()==130`), deep validation of the promised resource array must fail here rather than succeed via the nullable OffsetTo neuter path.

nodes.state: At the `tables.len` probe that drives the later BEInt load, the address of `tables.len` already lies beyond the sanitized blob end, so evaluating the table-count expression enters the ASan-reported out-of-bounds read.
The ResourceRecord that reaches `get_face` is the zero-filled null-pool record selected after the neutered `resourcesZ` dereference, so its non-nullable `offset` field is 0 on the crashing path.

edges.relation: The post-sanitize `resourcesZ` value that the vulnerable root step neuters to 0 is the same type-record offset later dereferenced by `get_resource_record`.
The exact ResourceRecord reference returned by the null-array lookup is the same record object later consumed by `ResourceRecord::get_face`.
The EOF `data_base` pointer passed into the vulnerable root validation step is reused unchanged when the selected zero-filled ResourceRecord is cast into an OpenTypeFontFace.
The forged OpenTypeFontFace returned from `ResourceRecord::get_face` is reinterpreted unchanged as `this` in the later `OffsetTable::find_table_index` sink path.
